section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the concept of positive body image and the evolution of its measurement, specifically the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and its refined version, BAS-2. It reviews findings from various international college and community samples regarding the factor structure, sex invariance, and construct validity of BAS-2 scores, including its associations with well-being and mixed correlations with BMI. The section does not present a new study but rather summarizes existing literature.
